model_role: frozen Qwen3 embedding encoder + downstream logistic directional classifiers
evaluation_window_note: Window capped at the last day present in the V3-5 score cache so the baseline and V3-Q3E are scored on the identical test window.

label.definition: 5-day forward close-to-close return vs volatility-scaled neutral band

leakage_controls.purge_applied: last <embargo_days> train and validation days dropped (label horizon overlap)
leakage_controls.no_same_day_price_leakage: features and entry both use close[T]; no close[T+k] in features
leakage_controls.news_timing: bundle[T] uses articles before the 16:00 ET close of day T (news_labeler)

trade_policy.exit: loose: 5% fixed stop, no trailing, exit when model no longer bullish
trade_policy.execution: market_on_close (decisions and fills at the close; no intraday stop)
trade_policy.note: Item 1 re-baseline: replaced the 1% intraday trailing stop (stop-market) with a loose MOC-executed exit — the only Alpaca-executable net-positive config.

v35_baseline.source: DeepSeek V3 finetuned directional cache replayed on the identical test window

best_variant.name: price_only_baseline
best_variant.selection_rule: max mean balanced accuracy, then mean net return at the primary (medium) threshold
